conviction_note: No results release exists on 2026-10-12. The row came from the UK RNS-calendar scraper, which read the sentence 'The next hearing before the Supreme Court is scheduled for 12 October 2026' in the FY2025 results RNS as a results date. Ferrexpo's own financial calendar (and its ICS entry) puts the next scheduled release, 3Q Production Results, on 2026-10-14, two sessions after the window closes. So event_confirmed is false, there are no findings and expected_move_pct is 0. abs_move_pct is 3.5 only because the stock still trades: an ordinary session at 66.6% annualised 20d vol (about 4.2% one-day sd), plus a small tail from the Ukrainian Supreme Court hearing that falls inside the window. That hearing has been adjourned repeatedly without a ruling, and nobody can say which way it goes, so p_up is 50.

NOT a results event, but dated inside the window: the Ukrainian Supreme Court (17-judge panel) hearing on the UAH4.7bn (US$105.4m) contested-sureties claim against FPM is scheduled for 12 October 2026. The interim report says an adverse final ruling could let the claimant start enforcement and 'could have a material negative impact on the Group's business activities and its ability to continue as a going concern'. The hearing has been adjourned several times without a substantive decision, and the claim is fully provisioned. It is recorded here and not as a finding because this stage ranks a results print and none exists. Unsized: sign and timing are unknowable, and it feeds only the tail in abs_move_pct.
